backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (CommentList, AppEvent, ChatMessage, ImageMeta, Settings) and CRUD operations for a comment/event management app, including comment generation with device-based deduplication and image/settings management.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that maps the old actor state to the new shape by preserving all existing fields and adding the new `usedTemplateIndices` map initialized as empty.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with their IDs, titles, associated files, components, and test IDs — covering the Single Comment Generator redesign, persistent deviceId logic, and related frontend changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'App Content & Feedback Manager' that mounts the React app at `#root` and loads the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component providing the app shell with a sticky header (logo, countdown timer, music toggle), floating shape decorations, four-tab navigation (User View, Upload, Live Checker, Admin), and background music management.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin gate component rendering a 4-digit password input form that calls `useAdminAuth`'s unlock function, displaying errors and a styled lock icon.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: A UI component that lets users select a comment list, choose a quantity, and generate multiple comments at once after validating an access key, with a copy-all feature.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: An SVG donut chart component that visually displays the percentage of used templates out of total templates, with a gradient arc and centered percentage text.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input, shoots at enemies by clicking, and tracks score and survival time.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that allows users to type and submit a comment to the backend via a mutation, showing loading, success, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an Internet Computer actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: A hook managing admin authentication via a hardcoded PIN code, persisting the unlocked state in sessionStorage with lock/unlock helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: A hook that manages an HTML Audio element for background music, supporting play/pause control and responding to changes in the music URL or enabled state.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: A hook providing utility functions to generate a single random comment or a bulk array of comments from a CommentList's templates, optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: A hook that returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to the next midnight, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: A hook that retrieves or generates a persistent unique device ID stored in localStorage, returning it as a stable string.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login/logout state and persisting identity via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including comment lists, app events, chat messages, settings, and list metrics.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Inter/Space Grotesk fonts, configuring Tailwind with a dark OKLCH-based design system, and defining utility classes for neon effects, glass cards, and gradient elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Utility that generates randomized app review comment templates based on configurable tone (positive/neutral/critical), category (performance/UI/features/support), and length.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: An admin view for generating comment templates locally based on a topic, tone, count, and optional appended symbol, with the ability to select and add generated templates to an existing comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: An admin chat panel that displays timestamped messages fetched from the backend (auto-refreshing every 5s) and allows sending new messages via an input field.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: An admin panel for managing comment lists, including creating new lists, adding templates via textarea, toggling list lock state, and viewing per-list metrics with a donut chart.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: An admin view for uploading images with a name, tags, and file picker (with preview and upload progress), and displaying the existing image library.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin view for managing live lists (app/events): supports creating, renaming, and deleting events, adding usernames via textarea or bulk file upload, and checking which events a username belongs to.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings panel for managing background music (toggle and file upload) and the access key used to unlock the Bulk Comments Generator, with options to set or auto-generate a random key.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Top-level admin panel component that gates access behind AdminUnlock and renders tabbed sub-views for Comments, AI Templates, Images, Chat, Live List, and Settings.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: A view component that lets users check whether usernames exist in app/event lists, displaying found/not-found results per app with expandable sections.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: A view component that provides three upload sections: uploading a single comment, generating bulk comments via BulkCommentGenerator, uploading comment templates from a text file to a selected list, and uploading rating images with name/tag metadata.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: A user-facing view that lets users select an app/event and comment list, generate a random comment template with device-based locking via localStorage, and copy the result to clipboard, including an embedded top-down shooter game.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, oklch-based color tokens, border radii, neon box shadows, and keyframe animations (fade-in, pulse-neon, accordion).
project_state.json: Project state snapshot (version 13) documenting the app's architecture, feature list, known issues, and design decisions such as admin auth via sessionStorage, device-based comment locking, and polling-based chat.
